title: Two actors pass an empty-target precondition and collide

scenario.observed_change: A create operation checks that a destination is absent and later publishes new state at that destination without an atomic no-clobber or version guard.
authority_boundaries: operation-owned new state versus concurrently created state

required_invariants.requirement: The absence precondition must remain valid through publication or publication must fail safely on collision.
The operation must not overwrite state created by another actor without authorization.

must_identify: a check-then-replace sequence can destroy concurrently created state
must_not_claim: safe creation merely because the destination was absent during preflight
